text.tspan: The risk that stopped the only comparable
firm is the one we cannot mitigate away
Client expectation is the binding risk; everything else is a preparation
Risk 1 sits alone in the top-right cell. It
is the only risk here that preparation
cannot remove, because it depends on
how clients react — and it is what
Gate A is the high-water mark;
Likelihood and impact ratings are the firm’s judgement, not findings — scenario data. The risks themselves are sourced; the ratings are
not. Accent marks a High rating, slate a Medium one.
External note: a Best Value Notice was issued to South Cambridgeshire District Council in November 2023, reissued in May 2024 and
allowed to expire in November 2024, alongside a statement that it is not government policy to support a general move to a four-day
week for five days’ pay. Relevant to a private firm only as a signal about external legitimacy.

g.text: Sources: Autonomy (2023) · 4 Day Week Foundation follow-up (2024) · Portugal final report (2024) · MHCLG
